reviewMethod: Read-only review of published candidate, prior installed-build evidence, and immutable installed-version source. No device actions or new inference.

receiptBinding.scope: Establishes PC receipt-to-inference attachment binding. Does not establish receipt delivery back to the phone.

buildEvidence.signingScope: Local Android Debug development certificate; Release variant with bundled JavaScript.

nativeAndroidBuild.implementationEvidence: Native Android build and physical installation are established independently by the recorded APK hash, signature check, adb installation and prior native UI observation.
nativeAndroidBuild.observationLimit: No contemporaneous phone observation or per-transfer build identifier was recorded for this second receipt. The earlier installed build is supporting context, not a new second-transfer observation.

certificatePinVerified.implementationEvidence: Installed-version PinnedHttps authenticates the server certificate fingerprint with a per-connection TrustManager and hostname verifier; redirects are disabled. Two Kotlin policy tests and two localhost HTTPS transport tests passed.
certificatePinVerified.conditionalInference: If this transfer was sent by that installed native code, it traversed the pinned HTTPS send path.
certificatePinVerified.observationLimit: No native TLS trace, second-transfer phone success observation, or physical wrong-pin rejection was collected. JVM policy and PC transport tests are not phone TLS execution evidence.

encryptedPendingQueue.implementationEvidence: Installed-version CameraX capture passes an in-memory JPEG into PendingStore.save before resolving. PendingStore encrypts image and metadata with Android Keystore AES-GCM and writes an AtomicFile under noBackupFilesDir. Send reads this encrypted record.
encryptedPendingQueue.conditionalInference: If this transfer was sent by that installed camera/send path, it passed through encrypted pending storage.
encryptedPendingQueue.observationLimit: No second-transfer pending UI, queue restart, ciphertext inspection or Android Keystore instrumentation result was collected. The later instrumentation APK compiled but was not executed.

deletedOnlyAfterReceipt.implementationEvidence: Installed-version send checks receipt device, transfer, encounter, image SHA, capture ID and timestamp; it persists the matching receipt in the encrypted record before removing the queue file.
deletedOnlyAfterReceipt.observationLimit: A durable PC receipt can exist even when its response is lost. This receipt alone cannot prove the phone received it or deleted its queue. No second-transfer pending-zero or success UI observation was collected. The earlier unrelated observation is excluded.
